name: # Message declaration parity: both shapes of main.msg build in both
# implementations and serialize to the same bytes. The declared shape is a
# LIST of definitions, each with the pattern as data (an ordered list of
# single-pair maps) and metadata as declared fields; the legacy shape nests
# the pattern pairs, so the pattern is the path to the definition.
# proxy-and-target is why the shape is a list: a gateway proxy and the
# message it forwards to share their last pattern pair, so a map keyed by
# message name could not hold both. Rows pass the built-in msg checks too -
# the parity runners wire the msg producer ahead of the model producer.
declared-list
proxy-and-target
legacy-chain
